test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**praised**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct sentence would be:

 
 
• ​Some people ***praised*** the work done by Subhas and his friends.
 
 
 
• ​***Praise*** means to show ***appreciation*** or approval for a person's accomplishments or other qualities.
